activation-access-map.rationale: The recovery pipeline consumes existing Production activation readiness as a final behavioral gate; it does not create a second activation authority.

activation-onboarding-map.rationale: The Production Recovery convergence feature does not add or change this dimension; it preserves the existing platform authority and data model unchanged.

asset-package-map.rationale: The Production Recovery convergence feature does not add or change this dimension; it preserves the existing platform authority and data model unchanged.

commercial-usage-map.rationale: The Production Recovery convergence feature does not add or change this dimension; it preserves the existing platform authority and data model unchanged.

connector-provider-map.rationale: Connector authentication recovery, bounded 429 classification, and two-phase credential rebind are composed through existing device and connector authorities without caller-supplied credentials.

data-model-domain-map.rationale: The feature orchestrates existing runtime, governance, and runtime-persistence schemas; zero-object classification is derived from durable full inspection and no new domain taxonomy is introduced.

delivery-support-map.rationale: Structured blocking_stage, error_code, request_id, and next_safe_action provide bounded operator recovery evidence without introducing a new support system.

execution-log-evidence-map.rationale: Every convergence run and step uses durable run identity, plan hash, step idempotency, append-only evidence, same-cycle readback, and secret-free terminal receipts.

migration-lifecycle-map.rationale: Governance and runtime-persistence baseline repair must precede ordinary migration, and 20260815_custom_gpt_mcp_catalog_levels.sql is gated after baseline and grants verification.

observability-release-map.rationale: The final state is active only after exact deployment SHA parity, functional readbacks, connector authentication, Local Manager E2E, and Production activation readiness.

platform-resource-graph-map.rationale: Recovery targets are resolved by server-owned runtime/governance/runtime-persistence bindings and existing resource authority, never from caller-selected database names.

platform-runtime-map.rationale: platform_recovery_converge_v1 composes Recovery Kernel operations into a resumable state machine while preserving nested authority and fail-closed execution.

policy-authority-map.rationale: Consequential steps require nested server-resolved approval/authority; the outer convergence operation never substitutes for step-bound approval, execution tickets, or post-write verification.

repository-automation-map.rationale: CI, E2E phase governance, generated artifact refresh, and exact-head certification remain repository-owned delivery controls and do not become runtime recovery authority.

repository-development-map.rationale: The Production Recovery convergence feature does not add or change this dimension; it preserves the existing platform authority and data model unchanged.

session-memory-map.rationale: The Production Recovery convergence feature does not add or change this dimension; it preserves the existing platform authority and data model unchanged.

work-map-coverage-matrix.rationale: The new Spec Kit is bound to the current 19-map/16-domain registry and records explicit decisions for every map and domain.

workflow-task-orchestration-map.rationale: The feature is a durable dependency-ordered recovery workflow with resumable checkpoints, stable per-step idempotency, unknown-outcome reconciliation, and no replay of verified steps.

workflow-and-tasks.label: Workflow & tasks
workflow-and-tasks.rationale: The convergence run is resumable, ordered, idempotent, and reconciliation-aware.

cross_map_dependencies.reason: No migration or grant repair may execute without nested Recovery authority and exact plan binding.
Zero-object role classification controls whether baseline rebuild is eligible.
Credential rebind and rate-limit recovery are conditional resumable stages inside the same run.
Final active status requires durable same-run evidence and behavioral readbacks.

dimension_discovery.no_new_dimensions_rationale: The recovery pipeline composes existing Recovery Kernel, database-role, connector/device, migration, workflow, and observability dimensions. No new taxonomy or schema domain is required.
